## Is AI Writing really that bad as they say?

Whenever I talk with writers or marketers, I hear echoes of discontent:

- _AI content is shallow, empty, and repetitive._
- _AI repeats stuff or adds a lot of fluff,_
- _My content writers can produce much better quality content._

Granted, AI will lead you down a dead-end without honing research or the art of resourceful prompts.

AI Writing seems to be complicated.

Advertised promises from various AI tools often fall flat, especially for those looking for [long-form content](https://seowind.io/long-form-content-seo/) solutions.

Then, there’s fear. Fear dominates discussions around AI – fear of adopting it, fear of job risk in marketing sectors, and fear of potential legal repercussions from using AI.

IMHO, there’s nothing inherently wrong with AI writing. It’s all about maneuvering it correctly.

Misuse it, and it won’t live up to your expectations. But mastering AI can open up a whole new frontier in content creation.

If deployed correctly, AI can provide a competitive advantage, accelerate content production, and enhance content quality, particularly for smaller teams. It can level the playing field against larger, more powerful competitors.

Consider the timeless tale of David vs. Goliath. Being the underdog positions you uniquely. You’re swift, agile, and able to pivot on a dime. There’s no need to navigate cumbersome bureaucratic processes to test new strategies or tools. Isn’t that liberating?

That’s the force AI puts in your hands.

What is needed is the correct method and the right tools. The rest will follow suit.

So, before we dive deeper into navigating AI writing, let’s debunk some widespread [myths and misconceptions](https://seowind.io/ai-writing-myths/) surrounding it.

## Debunking 3 Misconceptions about AI Writing

### 1\. AI Already Knows Everything  – A Three-Sentence Prompt is Adequate

A common mistake among AI writing is assuming a quick “Write me an outline on X topic” to a bot like ChatGPT will do the trick. They then expect a fully formed article or structured sections in return, while experienced users might provide more detailed commands. Regrettably, most individuals and businesses struggle to harness AI efficiently and typically either refrain from using it or remain dissatisfied with the results.

**Why is that flawed?**

Assigning tasks to AI isn’t fundamentally different from delegating to humans. Both require coherent, precise instructions for quality outcomes. The process of directing AI is mostly about supplying it with knowledge. Prompting is 1% about asking and 99% about providing knowledge to AI.

Want quality content? Supply AI with ample context like you would normally do with a human. We’ve never shied away from the task, and neither should you. The more exact and comprehensive your guidelines are, the higher the chances of obtaining satisfying content. We input about 7k words for every 3k words produced when creating articles. This proportion drastically impacts the quality of output. It’s a long-established programmer’s rule – “ [Garbage in, garbage out](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Garbage_in,_garbage_out)” – it’s time to apply this to our AI usage.

### 2\. AI-generated content is shallow, empty, and repetitive.

Certainly, AI can hallucinate. It can make things up or get too creative. BUT the content doesn’t have to be shallow. It greatly depends on you. Expecting A-class narratives or ranking articles from minimal data will always lead to disappointment. Lesser quality input equates to lower quality output.

**Why is this incorrect?**

Poor-quality content is a direct consequence of scant contribution. Do the research, analyze top-performing content, review questions people ask, and use it to get the output. Providing a solid structure and relevant context to the AI will stun you with its improved output quality. Do a similar test with a Content Writer, give them a task that lacks clarity, and verify if they understood your expectations. AI is no different than a human in this sense.

### 3\. AI content is not good enough for immediate publication

I often hear complaints that content created by AI can’t be published immediately. Honestly, what kind of quality do you expect from long-form content produced in just 20 minutes?

**Why is this incorrect?**

AI-generated content may not be flawless, but considering what it can generate within 20 minutes is still remarkable when compared to human speed. True, it might demand proofreading, but handy tools like Grammarly swiftly eliminate grammatical hiccups, minimize repetition and streamline sentences. Incorporating unique insights adds extra value to the content.

Pairing personal expertise with AI’s speed and efficiency is a potent combination. And it’s high time we all realized that.

## Stage 1: Create a Comprehensive Content Brief

![Stage 1: Create a Comprehensive Content Brief](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/stage-1-Create-a-Comprehensive-Content-Brief-1024x241.png)

Before using AI technology, outline your content needs and goals clearly. AI cannot intuit your expectations or figure out search engine algorithms. To generate well-ranking content, you must first take time to plan.

Regardless of who will write the content, an AI tool or a person, a detailed [content plan](https://seowind.io/how-to-create-a-content-plan/) is crucial for producing high-quality content. We’ve learned from discussions with more than 600 Marketing professionals that this stage generally takes one to three hours manually, depending on the level of detail desired. Note that certain steps can be automated and expedited, using platforms like SEOwind, to cut down time to about 5 to 15 minutes.

Here are the key tasks that will set you up to create top-notch content with your AI partner.

### 1\. Define the intent and the goal

Without setting a goal, you can’t achieve it. It’s as simple as that.

#### Why is it important?

Whenever you create content, you must recognize who it’s for and why it’s being developed. Often marketers and writers generate content to meet a publication rate, only to question why the desired results aren’t achieved.

#### How to go about it?

Start by setting clear aims for your AI-created content. Consider:

- Who is your target audience? Who are you creating this content for?
- What is the purpose of this article? Do you aim to entertain, teach, convince, or elicit feelings?

Identifying your objectives will assist you in crafting efficient instructions for AI-driven content.

### 2\. Conduct keyword research

Studying keywords isn’t restricted to search engine optimization (SEO) tactics. It’s about discovering the terms used when discussing your chosen subject. Hence, it involves identifying 20-30 keywords or more. The most successful articles rank for around 100 keywords as this helps increase the possibilities of gaining more natural traffic.

**NOTE:** We discourage the practice of keyword stuffing. When you precisely know the keywords your customers prefer, it becomes easier to communicate effectively using those terms. Therefore, using the right keywords shouldn’t be forced but should flow naturally.

#### Why is it important?

Examining keywords and incorporating them in your article or blog is vital for the following reasons:

- It helps you grasp [search intent](https://seowind.io/user-search-intent-seo/) and comprehend the types of topics answering user queries.
- It lets you understand your prospective customers’ language, needs, and how they describe things.
- It aids you in uncovering valuable content ideas based on people’s searches instead of guessing you possess all the necessary information.

#### How is it done?

Start by jotting down everything on a document. Don’t rely on memory!

Begin with a key phrase and input it into Google. Go through top Search Engine Results Pages (SERPs). See what keywords they rank high for using SEO tools that offer such information. Consider:

- Their rankings for these keywords. If they rank in the top 30, it signifies the content’s relevance to the search engine.
- The amount of times a keyword is searched monthly, on average, in a particular location.
- Keyword difficulty determines how tough it is to rank for a keyword.

#### Useful tools

- [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/): users get the keywords for the top 10 SERPs ranking within the first 30 positions and with search volume above 10
- Paid keyword research tools: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/) or [Ahrefs](https://ahrefs.com/)
- Free keyword research tools: [Google Keyword Planner](https://ads.google.com/home/tools/keyword-planner/), [Ubbersuggest](https://neilpatel.com/ubersuggest/), [Answe](https://answerthepublic.com/) [r](https://answerthepublic.com/) [The Public](https://answerthepublic.com/), or [Keywords Everywhere](https://keywordseverywhere.com/)

#### Tips for identifying keywords

- To identify suitable keywords, you should check their search volume. If you are new to creating content, consider more specific keywords often searched for less (10-300 times) rather than broad terms attracting more competition.
- You should also remember the keyword difficulty. If you are starting your journey in content creation, it’s wise to choose keywords with low (20-30) to medium (30-45) difficulty.

#### Recommended Resources

- [How to do SEO Keyword Research in 2023 – Step-by-Step Guide](https://seowind.io/how-to-do-seo-keyword-research/)
- [Discover the Best Keyword Research Tools of 2023](https://seowind.io/keyword-research-tools/)

#### Keyword clustering

You can utilize artificial intelligence to assist you in grouping relevant keywords. By [clustering similar keywords](https://seowind.io/keyword-clustering-seo/), you can produce more specific and related content. When [writing blog posts](https://seowind.io/how-long-does-it-take-to-write-a-blog-post/), using clusters of keywords can be quite helpful, as they are categorized by resemblance and can usually be interchanged or placed near one another.

Simply go to ChatGPT and use the following suggestion:

_Use the following list of keywords and group them together to create content clusters: \[list of keywords\]_

![clustering keywords prompt](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Clustering-keywords-1024x679.png)

For more useful SEO prompts in ChatGPT, check out our article: [Unlock the potential of ChatGPT to boost SEO results \[with ready-to-use prompts\]](https://seowind.io/chatgpt-seo-prompts/)

### 3\. Create a detailed blog outline based on SERPs and SEO data

The most important stage, greatly impacting the article content you generate using AI, is to create a comprehensive blog outline. Study the most successful search results to generate high-class content surpassing your rivals. This method helps you comprehend what Google finds valuable in specific search queries. It also empowers you to construct content based on that foundation to create a more engaging article.

#### Why is it important?

Companies that [appear on Google’s first page](https://seowind.io/how-do-i-get-on-the-first-page-of-google/) have successfully addressed the search intent.

By studying top-ranking pages’ structure, subject matter, and inquiries, you can draft a plan that likewise engages your viewers.

You aim to give the reader greater value by making your article more inclusive, practical, or visually engaging. Use the themes covered by the top-ranking pages as foundation stones. Select only the ones that align with your objectives and create content better than every individual search result!

**Remember:** While taking a unique path and not following the ones set by high-ranking content is tempting, this may not always be advantageous. Google tends to have a specific search intent for a keyword, and if you don’t cater to this, you may fail to rank among the top articles. According

to our experience, signaling search intent and adding extra value often yield better results than ignoring the common trends.

#### How can you do it?

Start by opening the doc file where you’ve collected your keywords. After you type in your target keyword, open each search result on a new tab, ending up with 8-10 pages. Look at your competitors’ pages by reviewing their [headings and subheadings](https://seowind.io/headings-and-subheadings/). Look for common themes, unique topics, and possibilities to enhance your content. Utilize this information to develop your content plan in the doc file.

#### Helpful tools

Tools for analyzing search results and generating SEO content can help significantly. For instance, SEOwind offers all-embracing competitor analysis by comparing all competitor outlines. Thus, it helps users make data-based conclusions and swiftly generate briefs. SEOwind collects data from search results and competitors to feed its AI model, resulting in comprehensive briefs that meet search intent.

#### IMPORTANT

Avoid using ChatGPT to draft your plan, as it lacks knowledge of search results and search intent unless you input this information. Since it’s a language model and not a knowledge model, it will produce a reasonably relevant plan, but it will be mostly guesswork and may not seem logical. For the best results, utilize AI-generated outlines derived from search results analysis.

#### Recommended Resources

- [The Definitive Guide to Writing a Content Outline](https://seowind.io/content-outline-article-blog/)
- [Everything you need to know about SEO Content Brief – Ultimate Guide](https://seowind.io/content-brief/)

### 4\. Answer Frequently Asked Questions

To distinguish yourself from competitors, try taking a step further than what they offer. Likewise, aim to cater to your audience by addressing their questions and concerns.

#### Why is this important?

Delving into your audience’s concerns can make your content more distinct and valuable. As a result, you’ll likely see increased audience engagement and [boosted search engine ranking](https://seowind.io/organic-search-engine-rankings/).

#### How can you achieve this?

Locate your users’ questions by making use of resources like:

- Google’s ‘People Also Ask’, which shows additional questions related to a user’s search
- Suggestions offered through Google’s Related Searches
- Question-and-answer site Quora
- Discussion platform Reddit
- Any other relevant niche forums or communities.

A great method to identify questions is by speaking to your customers. Address their interests based on the knowledge you acquire from your conversations.

#### Tips

A handy tip is to use Google when searching Quora or Reddit. In our experience, Google excels at finding relevant topics. To do this, simply go to Google and type ‘site:quora.com {keyword}’ or ‘site:reddit.com {keyword}’. The first part of the query (‘site:reddit.com’) restricts Google’s search to a specific domain. By adding your keyword, Google will focus on finding topics that align with your interests.

#### Useful tools

- [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/) – In addition to analyzing SEO data, SEOwind collects questions from People Also Ask, Quora, and Reddit, making it easy to gather all relevant information in one place.
- [Ahrefs Keyword Generator](https://ahrefs.com/keyword-generator) – Discover question keywords, keyword difficulty, and search volume.
- [Answer the Public](https://answerthepublic.com/) – This tool uses an extensive database to predict what users will ask in their search queries.
- [Keywords Everywhere](https://keywordseverywhere.com/) – A browser add-on for Chrome and Firefox that provides monthly search volume, CPC, and competition metrics across multiple devices.
- [KWFinder](https://mangools.com/kwfinder/) – Lists all the relevant question keywords.
- [Semrush Keyword Magic Tool](https://www.semrush.com/features/keyword-magic-tool/) – Generates an extensive list of related keywords to help uncover more user questions.

### 5\. Adopting Your Brand Voice to AI Content

Let’s discuss tailoring your AI content to reflect your brand’s style and voice. A common challenge with AI is that it sometimes lacks a personal touch. Ever read something that doesn’t quite sound like your brand? That’s what we’re discussing.

#### Why does it matter?

Each brand has a unique communication style: consistently engaging with its audience. It’s comparable to preparing a predictable cup of coffee every time. People become accustomed to it, appreciate it, and that’s what keeps them coming back. Depending on the content, you may require a specific tone. For instance, informative or educational posts might require a more authoritative tone, while personal or emotional topics may require a more empathetic tone.

The challenge is how to incorporate this into AI-generated content.

The encouraging news is that there are options available. You have two main methods to make AI write more like you: providing distinct prompts or strong examples. Let’s talk about these options in detail.

#### Option \#1 Clearly State Your Writing Style and Voice

The first choice is to lay out your writing style and voice clearly. ChatGPT is designed to handle a variety of conversational styles by offering different voice and tone options. Each option has its purpose and can help you achieve the desired feeling in your communication.

**Examples of Writing Styles**

Here are a few writing style samples:

1. Professional: Provide opinions supported by reasons and clarifications.
2. Conversational: Speak as you would to a friend, in a friendly and familiar manner.
3. Humorous: Light, funny and sure to entertain your audience.
4. Empathetic: Thoughtful and kind, especially suitable for sensitive subjects.
5. Simple: Clear, using easy-to-understand language.
6. Academic: Comprehensive and in-depth, filled with plenty of research.
7. Creative: Original and thought-provoking, stimulating thought and creativity.

**Examples of Tone of Voice**

Now, let’s consider the tone of voice. The aim is to resonate with your audience. You could strive for:

01. Authoritative: Make declarations that show your knowledge.
02. Calming: Ease your readers’ anxieties.
03. Compelling: Attract your readers’ attention.
04. Curious: Evoke interest and curiosity.
05. Engaging: Maintain your readers’ attention.
06. Excited: Express your enthusiasm.
07. Formal: Avoid informal language and maintain a strictly professional tone.
08. Friendly: Make your readers feel welcome.
09. Funny: Throw in a joke or two.
10. Informative: Provide helpful information.
11. Inspirational: Encourage your readers.
12. Witty: Implement smart humor.
13. Optimistic: Maintain a positive outlook.
14. Worried: Expose concern or urgency.

For a change, you can also attempt writing as:

- A character from a book
- A celebrity
- A particular author

**Examples of Useful Prompts**

Now, let’s look at some examples of writing prompts that you can use:

```
Your writing style is conversational and persuasive. Use logical arguments and stats, keep things clear and concise but dial down on the humor.

Your writing style is explanatory, breaking down complex ideas and subjects into simple terms while incorporating examples and visual aids to illustrate the points made.

Your writing style is informative, objectively presenting facts and data while incorporating clear headings, bullet points, and concise language.

Your writing style is informative, friendly, and engaging, incorporating humor and real-life examples to brighten things up.
```

#### Option 2: Let ChatGPT define your Writing Style

Sometimes, it is hard to accurately convey the tone and writing style you want. But there’s a solution.

You can give ChatGPT a writing example and a cue. Then, see what happens. GPT technology will evaluate your content, data, and language to create a unique writing style. What’s great about this? It’s crafted for your readers and matches your brand seamlessly.

Here’s an example of a cue you could use:

**Sample prompt to use** – **Prompt no 1**

```
Based on the tone and writing style in the seed text, analyze and describe the style, voice, and tone of writing. We will use this input when providing instructions to AI or humans.

Beneath this, type “SEED TEXT” and then enter your example.
```

**_Outcome:_**

## Stage 2: Create articles using AI

![Stage 2: Create articles using AI](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/stage-Create-articles-with-AI-1024x241.png)

After determining all your necessary data, it’s time to use AI to elevate your writing. Consider AI as your personal writer and prompts as the instructions it requires to achieve the results you want.

### Best ways to create prompts for AI article writing

Creating an effective AI prompt could be a major step in your journey to produce high-impact articles with GPT-based tools. Using the right strategy, you can guide the tool to generate long content that is captivating and informative.

Here are some top tips to help you excel in creating helpful prompts for AI blog writing:

#### Give context to AI content writer

Start by stating the goal of your content and the viewpoint you wish to convey. Consider these points:

- Who is writing the article?
- How is it communicated?
- What is their viewpoint?
- You can use terms such as “Act as…”
- Include your product or service info. This lets the AI recognize your industry by offering relevant details.

#### Describe the task

When detailing the task, be as specific as possible. Provide info like:

- Purpose of the content
- Target readers
- Comprehensive SEO outline
- Keywords to focus on
- Queries to answer.

#### Provide instructions

You can include directions to follow:

- Specify the language: Include the style, tone, and proficiency level you want the AI to use in the content.
- Define the layout: Suggest the arrangement of the article. Does it need to have ordered or unordered lists? What should be the depth of headings? This will assist the AI in creating a well-structured article.
- Indicate the correct length: State your preferred length for your article. This will help the AI create content that meets your needs.
- Use examples: Offering examples or sample sentences in your prompt can guide the AI’s writing style and give it a clearer understanding of the tone and language you’re looking for.
- Indicate the format: Specify whether you want the content as a tutorial, an opinion piece, a list, or another specific format. This will guide the AI to adjust its writing style to your needs.
- Add storytelling components: Encourage the AI to employ storytelling techniques to make your content more relatable. Offer guidelines on the type of story or narrative you’d like to see in the article.

#### IMPORTANT:

- Be mindful of the language you use in your prompt. Be explicit and use verbs. Avoid any vagueness, as it can cause less satisfactory results.
- Remember, the quality of AI-produced content heavily depends on the input data used. Better prompts lead to better content. Expect random and less relevant responses if your request is vague or lacks context.
- This is just the start. Update and evolve your prompt. If you dislike certain phrases the AI uses, tell it specifically not to use them. State it if you want more of something, like metaphors and anecdotes.
- Ask for revisions or changes. Don’t hesitate to ask the AI to modify or repeat its output. You can offer additional guidance, clarify your expectations, or request specific sections be expanded or rewritten. This will help you refine the content until it meets your expectations.

### Sample AI prompt for article writing

Let’s say you’re an owner of an online and offline garden store and you want to write an in-depth, long-form article on how to grow blueberries. Here, we’ll walk through a sample prompt.

```
Context
You’re a passionate and experienced gardener who is running an online and offline garden store. You know gardening inside and out as you’ve been in the field for over 20 years. In your store, you have garden plants, fruit trees, vegetables, house plants, and garden supplies. You love sharing your knowledge on how to take care of plants so that they have optimal conditions for growth. You have an exceptional vocabulary in this field and you love writing about it.

Task
Your task is to write a guide with suggestions for how to grow blueberries. The guide should have at least 2500 words. The goal of this guide is to educate people on how to grow and take care of blueberries so that they grow a lot of sweet fruits.

The guide should have the following outline:
H2 - Introduction to Growing Blueberries
H2 - Types of Blueberries
H2 - When to Plant Blueberry Bushes
H2 - Choosing and Preparing a Planting Site
H2 - How to Plant Blueberry Bushes
H2 - Can You Grow Blueberries in a Container?
H2 - How to Care for Blueberry Bushes
H2 - How to Prune Blueberry Bushes
H2 - How to Harvest Blueberries
H2 - How to Store Blueberries
H2 - Common Pests & Plant Diseases
H2 - Common Problems With Blueberries

Below there are relevant keywords, clustered in a semantic way, that you should use across the guide:
- blueberries where to plant, best place to plant blueberry bushes,
- blueberry planting, blueberry when to plant, best time to plant blueberries, when is the best time to plant blueberry bushes, best season for blueberries
- blueberries how to grow, blueberry bush how to plant,
- blueberries growing tips, blueberry planting guide, tips for growing blueberries, how to grow sweeter blueberries
- blueberry bushes care, blueberry plant care
- how to plant a blueberry bush, how to plant a blueberry, how to grow a blueberry bush
- spacing for blueberry bushes, blueberry bush spacing, blueberries plant spacing
what do blueberries grow on
- best soil for blueberries, conditions for growing blueberries, type of soil for blueberries, soil type blueberries, blueberries soil requirements
- how much sun do blueberry bushes need, how much sun do blueberries need, how many hours of sun do blueberries need
- blueberry cultivation
- different types of blueberries, are there different types of blueberries
how far apart to plant blueberries, how close to plant blueberry bushes, how much space do blueberry bushes need, distance between blueberry bushes

Instruction
Your writing style is informative, friendly, and engaging while incorporating real-life examples. I want you to write in the same way you would write to a friend, using a conversational tone.

Write the article.
```

Voilà. You’re ready to have your article written.

**Important**: If you’re using [ChatGPT for writing content](https://seowind.io/how-to-write-a-prompt-chatgpt/), be aware that it can stop producing content after 500 words and will cut off mid-sentence. If it happens, check where it stopped and continue from the heading it stopped at.

The other option is to just write “continue where you stopped,” but this is less predictive.

## Stage 3: Give it a Human Touch

![Stage 3: Give it a Human Touch](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/stage-3-give-it-a-human-touch-1024x241.png)

The process isn’t over yet. For exceptional results, you should add a personal touch.

AI-generated content serves as a solid base that you can enhance further.

Here are our suggestions to personalize AI-generated content:

### 1\. Examine and modify AI-produced material

Go over the AI-generated content. The algorithm may produce errors or irrelevant details, so it’s necessary to:

- Update out-of-date details
- Exclude references to competitors or industry leaders
- Modify phrases that don’t align with your style
- Adjust the structure as needed.

This ensures that your brand and intended message align with the AI-generated content.

### 2\. Inject your own knowledge and personality

You are an expert in your area. Add your unique insights, expertise and real-world examples to enhance the content. This personal touch will make the content more captivating and boosts your audience’s credibility.

### 3\. Always fact-check

AI-generated content may contain quotes, hyperlinks, or data that require validation. You should always cross-check AI-created content to guarantee the information’s reliability. This is key to upholding your audience’s trust and your status as a trusted source of information. For instance, the GPT4 has about a 50-70% accuracy rate, so always double-check the facts.

### 4\. Prioritize SEO

The AI is not versed in SEO, so you must optimize the content for search engines. Use [SEO tools for your content to rank higher](https://seowind.io/seo-content-writing-tools/) in search results. Include appropriate keywords and themes to ensure your content is valuable for your target audience. This might need adding more parts or headlines to address other viewpoints.

### 5\. Double-check the grammar and length of sentences

AI tools sometimes form longer and more complicated sentences, which may not always benefit your audience. Therefore, always proofread your content with an emphasis on grammar and the length of sentences. Offer guidelines to the AI writing tool for sentence formation, but be prepared to modify manually if the AI does not get it right.

### 6\. Utilize internal linking

Add [internal links](https://seowind.io/internal-linking-seo/) within the AI-generated content to complementary content on your site. This keeps readers fascinated and urges them to explore more of your site, eventually improving your site’s overall SEO ranking.

### 7\. Include visuals

Embedding visuals within your content aids in effectively conveying your ideas and keeping your audience engaged. Break up extensive text sections and enrich the user experience by incorporating relevant images, infographics, graphs, or videos. Visuals can simplify intricate concepts, making the content understandable to many readers.

By observing these steps and adding a human touch to your content, you can create outstanding pieces that align with your audience and accurately deliver your message. Remember that AI is a tool designed to aid you, but your knowledge and personal touch make the final output distinctive.

**Step 3: Data-Driven Content Outline Creation**

Starting with the primary keyword, we use SEOwind to conduct content research. It gives us [competitive analysis](https://seowind.io/competitive-analysis-seo/), competitor outlines, questions to answer, and ranking keywords.

Our tool uses AI to create titles, [meta descriptions](https://seowind.io/meta-description/), and AI outlines, which we treat as a strong starting point. We add to the outline our insights, tips, best practices, and our product where relevant.

We also add secondary keywords. SEOwind provides keywords that top SERPs rank in the top 30. This way, you can rank with this content for such keywords.

Tools: SEOwind

**Step 4: AI Article Writing**

We use SEOwind to write the article, with detailed prompts on context, tasks, and instructions in the background.

**Step 5: Proofreading & Editing**

We carefully check content for:

And voila! You can publish your AI-generated content.

### 5 Top Learnings on CyborgMethod™ in Practice

#### Finding no 1

Briefing Humans is no different than Prompting AI.

If you want quality content, you must provide detailed input to AI. Give it as much context as possible. Do the research, analyze top-performing content, review questions people ask, and use it to get the output.

Don’t cut corners. It’s not worth it.

#### Finding no 2

It’s all about the quality of briefs you create.

A comprehensive and well-researched brief is fundamental for high-quality content. Poor brief and outline = poor AI article with repetitions. Invest your time. Good research is worth it.

#### Finding no 3

You can’t scale content without Tools. Don’t be a cheapskate.

Producing more quality content requires being smart and efficient. Manual work is a cost too. Leverage AI and SEO tools to power up content production. It’s cheaper this way.

#### Finding no 4

It’s all about good planning

Scaling content within a small team means you need to be very efficient. Well-thought processes and execution are what helped us get results.

#### Finding no 5

By teaming up with AI, you can coordinate writing multiple articles at once.

With AI tools, you can simultaneously write 3-4 articles. Cool, right? Once you have keywords you are after, you can create briefs for them. When SEOwind writes the article, you can take care of another brief.
